## Standards checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Every new factual claim has a cited source (or is labeled as an industry estimate).
- [ ] All internal relative links resolve correctly.
- [ ] All external URLs were verified to return HTTP 200 at submission time.
- [ ] No NDA-bound or confidential materials are quoted or paraphrased.
- [ ] No embedded copyrighted images, logos, or trademarks.
- [ ] Markdown renders correctly (I previewed it in my fork).
- [ ] For entries, the "what will a designer learn" question has a clear answer.
